errors.text_span: Всяка възрастова група съдържа пет стълба
errors.evidence: The chart is grouped by age and then by gender. Each gender within an age group has five bars, meaning each age group category on the x-axis contains ten bars in total (five for 'Жена' and five for 'Мъж').
The color for the fifth category, '5. Силно несъгласен', is dark blue, not green. There are no green bars in the chart.

errors.evidence: The example refers to the '19-25' age group. In this group, the bar for 'Мъж' (Man) and 'Силно несъгласен' (Strongly disagree) has a value of 21%, not 0%. A value of 0% for this category is seen for men in the '26-34' age group.

errors.text_span: Някои стълбове са визуално подчертани с по-наситен цвят.
errors.evidence: This is a vague and incorrect description of the color scheme. The chart uses two distinct shades of blue (light and dark) to represent two different categories ('Силно съгласен' and 'Силно несъгласен'), not to visually emphasize certain bars.
